version.changelog:
Initial release of ab-test-analyzer

- 自动导入和分析 A/B 测试数据
- 支持统计显著性计算和可视化报告生成
- 提供基于数据的优化建议
- 支持多变量测试场景
- 适用于产品、运营、增长等多种用例

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: ab-test-analyzer
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle contains only documentation and metadata for an A/B testing analysis tool. The files (SKILL.md, skill.json, and _meta.json) describe standard data analysis features such as importing CSVs and calculating statistical significance without any executable code, suspicious network calls, or prompt-injection attacks.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions are consistent with an A/B test analysis helper and do not request unrelated credentials, installs, or system access.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and declared requirements align: an A/B test analyzer should import CSV data, compute significance, visualize results, and provide suggestions. There are no unrelated env vars, binaries, or config paths requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md limits actions to importing test_data.csv, analyzing metrics, and producing reports. It does not instruct reading arbitrary system files or exfiltrating data. Note: this skill is instruction-only with no code — the document contains CLI examples (openclaw run ...) but provides no implementation; verify the runtime implementation separately before running on sensitive data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or downloads are present (instruction-only), so nothing will be written to disk by an installer step.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are required. The declared needs are proportional to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and there are no indications the skill requests persistent system privileges or modifies other skills. disable-model-invocation is false (normal); this only means the agent could invoke it autonomously.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This SKILL.md is coherent for an A/B analysis helper and does not request secrets or installs, but it is instruction-only (no code provided). Before installing or running: 1) confirm the agent runtime or provider implementation of 'ab-test-analyzer' comes from a trusted source; 2) test on non-sensitive/sample CSVs first; 3) verify at runtime whether any network requests are made (to avoid unexpected data exfiltration); and 4) avoid uploading PII unless you trust the implementation and destination.
